Richard Werstine, wanted in connection with killing of Cold as Life vocalist Rodney Barger, was arrested in Panama A suspect accused of murdering his rock singer friend in 1993 has been apprehended in Central America after spending more than 30 years successfully evading authorities. According to the US Marshals Service, Richard Werstine, who was wanted in connection with the killing of Cold as Life vocalist Rodney Barger, was arrested in Panama. Investigators say Barger, who was 23 years old, was Werstine’s roommate and close friend when Werstine allegedly shot him in the head as he slept inside their Detroit residence on 15 September 1993.

A Michigan fugitive who allegedly murdered his best friend and rock singer roommate was arrested as authorities discovered he’d been hiding in Central America as a “ghost” for over three decades. Richard Werstine, 56, was captured at a dog park in Panama City, Panama, on April 29 after he’d been on the run following the alleged killing of Cold as Life frontman Rodney Barner, 23, inside their Detroit home back on Sept. 15, 1993, according to the US Marshals Service. Werstine — who had gone by several names, including Joseph Alan Stavros — was found in possession of fraudulent identification and was only identified after having his fingerprints scanned. Barner, also known by his stage name, Rawn Beauty, was fatally shot in the head in his sleep.

DETROIT – The U.S. Marshals Service’s Detroit Fugitive Apprehension Team has arrested a Detroit man who they said had been on the run for more than 30 years after being accused of a 1993 murder. “He was a ghost since ‘94,” a federal source told Local 4 Monday. “He was very cunning, very crafty while on the run.” Richard Werstine, also known as Joseph Alan Stavros, 56, is wanted in the Sept. 15, 1993, killing of his roommate, Rodney Barger, aka “Rawn Beauty,” 23, who was the lead singer of the punk rock band Cold as Life. Werstine was arrested by Detroit police days later but failed to appear for trial, and a warrant was issued in June 1994, the feds said.

[Lähde: The Guardian World]
Richard Werstine, wanted in connection with killing of Cold as Life vocalist Rodney Barger, was arrested in Panama

A suspect accused of murdering his rock singer friend in 1993 has been apprehended in Central America after spending more than 30 years successfully evading authorities.

According to the US Marshals Service, Richard Werstine, who was wanted in connection with the killing of Cold as Life vocalist Rodney Barger, was arrested in Panama.

Investigators say Barger, who was 23 years old, was Werstine’s roommate and close friend when Werstine allegedly shot him in the head as he slept inside their Detroit residence on 15 September 1993.

Authorities said Werstine, now 56, was taken into custody at a dog park in Panama City, Panama, on 29 April after decades as a fugitive following the alleged murder of Barger. Officials also said he was carrying fake identification at the time of his arrest, but fingerprint testing later confirmed his identity.

Detroit police first detained Werstine just days after Barger’s death, but officials say he never showed up for trial proceedings. A warrant for his arrest was issued in June 1994.

“The tenacity and commitment of the US Marshals Service working to bring Werstine and those like him into police custody where they belong is at the forefront of our daily mission here in Detroit,” chief deputy marshal Jimmy Allen said in a statement.

Allen added: “His arrest not only works toward bringing closure to the friends and family who have lost a loved one but also demonstrates our promise to pursue those who think they can prey on the members of our communities without being held accountable.”

In May 2022, the marshals assumed responsibility for Werstine’s case related to his failure to appear on murder charges. During the investigation, authorities learned he had been arrested multiple times over the years while using different aliases, though his real identity had remained unknown.

“He was a ghost since ’94,” a federal source told WDIV. “He was very cunning, very crafty while on the run.”

After his apprehension, Werstine confessed to being on the run from authorities, the outlet reported. He also reportedly said he had entered Panama illegally in 2005 and admitted to never obtaining legal status.

Officials have not disclosed a motive in the 1993 killing.

The singer was described as a “fabled wild-man vocalist,” whose antics became the backdrop for many of the band’s songs, according to Revolver Magazine.

Werstine was arrested days after the heinous murder but failed to appear in court as he was set to stand trial, instead skipping town and going on the lam.

Authorities issued a warrant for Werstine’s arrest in June 1994. A motive for the 1993 murder has not been revealed.

Officials did not say if additional charges would be added to Werstine’s case.

Werstine, using his alternate names, escaped police detection despite being arrested multiple times in Michigan, Arizona and other places on arson and gun charges, according to the outlet.

Officials tracked Werstine down to Panama City before authorities moved in on him back in April.

After his arrest, Werstine admitted to using a fake name and living in Panama illegally since 2005, never obtaining legal status.

payload.title: Yli 30 vuotta etsitty murhaepäilty pidätettiin Panamassa
payload.summary: Yhdysvalloissa 1990-luvun murhasta epäilty Richard Werstine on otettu kiinni Panamassa vuosikymmeniä kestäneen pakoilun jälkeen. Häntä etsitään Cold as Life -yhtyeen laulajan Rodney Bargerin kuolemaan liittyen.
payload.content:
Yhdysvalloissa vuonna 1993 tapahtuneesta henkirikoksesta etsitty Richard Werstine on pidätetty Panamassa yli 30 vuotta kestäneen pakoilun jälkeen. Yhdysvaltain Marshals Service -viranomaisen mukaan Werstineä etsitään Cold as Life -yhtyeen laulajan Rodney Bargerin surmaan liittyen Detroitissa.

## Pidätys tehtiin Panama Cityssä

Werstine, 56, otettiin kiinni Panama Cityssä 29. huhtikuuta. Lähdetietojen mukaan hänet tavoitettiin koirapuistosta. Viranomaisten mukaan hän oli oleskellut Keski-Amerikassa pitkään ja käyttänyt useita nimiä, muun muassa nimeä Joseph Alan Stavros.

Pidätyksen yhteydessä Werstinen hallusta löydettiin väärennettyjä henkilöllisyysasiakirjoja. Hänen henkilöllisyytensä varmistettiin sormenjälkien avulla. Paikalliselle medialle puhunut liittovaltion lähde kuvasi häntä henkilöksi, joka oli ollut viranomaisille kuin ”haamu” vuodesta 1994 lähtien.

## Tapaus liittyy vuoden 1993 ampumiseen Detroitissa

Tutkijoiden mukaan Barger oli Werstinen kämppäkaveri ja läheinen ystävä. Barger oli 23-vuotias ja Cold as Life -punkyhtyeen laulaja, joka tunnettiin myös taiteilijanimellä Rawn Beauty. Epäilyn mukaan hänet ammuttiin päähän hänen nukkuessaan heidän yhteisessä asunnossaan Detroitissa 15. syyskuuta 1993.

Lähteissä uhrin sukunimi esiintyy myös muodossa Barner, mutta viranomais- ja paikallislähteissä häneen viitataan Cold as Life -yhtyeen laulajana. Werstine pidätettiin Detroitin poliisin toimesta pian tapahtuman jälkeen, mutta viranomaisten mukaan hän ei myöhemmin saapunut oikeudenkäyntiin.

## Oikeusprosessi jatkuu kiinnioton jälkeen

Werstinestä annettiin pidätysmääräys kesäkuussa 1994. Sen jälkeen hänen kerrotaan vältelleen viranomaisia yli kolmen vuosikymmenen ajan, kunnes Detroitin pakoilijoiden kiinniottoon erikoistunut viranomaisryhmä osallistui hänen tavoittamiseensa Panamassa.

Kiinniotto päättää pitkän etsintävaiheen, mutta ei ratkaise rikosasiaa. Werstineä koskevat väitteet käsitellään oikeusprosessissa, jossa ratkaistaan hänen syyllisyytensä tai syyttömyytensä.
summary_bullets: Richard Werstine pidätettiin Panama Cityssä yli 30 vuoden pakoilun jälkeen.
Häntä epäillään Cold as Life -yhtyeen laulajan Rodney Bargerin surmasta Detroitissa vuonna 1993.
Viranomaisten mukaan Werstine käytti toista nimeä ja hänet tunnistettiin sormenjäljistä.
payload.journalist_note: Lähteissä uhrin sukunimi esiintyy sekä muodossa Barger että Barner; artikkelissa käytetty muoto Barger, mutta epävarmuus huomioitu tekstissä. Syyllisyyttä ei esitetä varmana.
